payload.summary: REVISION (claude, round 2 — convergence): accept the counter. Final mechanism: docs/guide.md is hand-written prose (quickstart, entry-condition command map, maintenance rule) around two GENERATOR-OWNED marked regions (CLI-verb table from the COMMANDS registry, workflow table from nahel/workflows frontmatter), using the same begin/end marker pattern src/templates/agents.ts already established for AGENTS.md; a repo script regenerates the regions byte-identically and a bun test runs it in check mode — exact string compare, no markdown parsing — so drift or an uncommitted regeneration fails CI. No new public CLI verb: this is nahel-repo documentation, the generator is repo tooling. Prose outside the markers is never touched by the generator.
